notes.subject: car
notes.text: Only Generation 2 coverage, some of the oldest: low quality, washed-out and overexposed colours with round blurs above and below the camera.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Black plates with white text, long or square.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Cylindrical grey lamp posts with a black painted bottom; Hong Kong's are similar but lack the black base.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Signs combine Chinese with a European colonial-era language, especially on storefronts.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: White street signs with a blue border and two-language text are unique here.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Many lavish, kitsch casinos and gambling ads; several new ones appear under construction.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The north has dense apartment blocks, narrow gridded streets and cars parked on both sides.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The south is hilly and rural, with narrow winding roads, trees on both sides and frequent lamp posts.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: A bridge with cuboid towers that have arches cut into them.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Red guardrails mark the Amizade Bridge.
